svg.text: an armoured manta that drives on all four tyres
A low, wide ray. Wings fold down over geared wheel pods; a slatted mouth with four sonar eyes sits above a chrome duck-bill scoop; layered armour plates run back to a short finned tail.
low wide shell, wings drooping over the wheels, dark slatted grille as the mouth
seams as graphics, round top vent (= IR start window), short tail, two low fins
wheels hidden in pods behind round tyre windows; red line along each wing crown
long bill reaching forward: the chrome scoop is the lowest leading edge
stepped armour plates over the back; ribbed black parts where hands go
two-tone layering: pearl carapace over orange wings over a gunmetal keel
decals: 08, hazard bars, barcode (the duck-mech sticker sheet)
the frame lives inside: a gunmetal keel tub carries every load, the shell only skins it
4 tyres · no size or weight limit · AED 367 budget · PLA on a Bambu A1 mini (any number of plates) · no laser sensor
same bought parts: 2 × JGB37-520, 4 × TT Ø 66, L298N, ESP32, LM2596, 3S 18650, 2 × HC-SR04, 4 × TCRT5000, VS1838B
battle: nothing tall or thin to grab (fins 14 over the crest) · scoop is the lowest leading edge · skirts 5 off the mat
sumo v5 · chassis schematics · rev A · 2026-11-14
what the eleven references give the robot, and the livery
mm · x right, y forward, z up · mat at z 0 · for review, not for print
